correctness.rationale: Bijective monic coefficient parametrization and the Capelli norm criterion give precisely the stated three character constraints. All zero-character boundary terms have been checked: exactly one spurious unit at (t,x)=(0,0). Exact complete pair sums 0,q,q and triple sum 1+chi(-1) yield N3 algebraically. The closed N1,N2 counts follow from standard quadratic sums, and an independent enumerator verified 14 fields and genuine iterate irreducibility in four prime fields; finite evidence is not used as proof.
